title: Resilience Timeline: Propeller Panel for Dedicated GPU Pools
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Summary: Design a compact ‘Propeller’ resilience timeline panel that surfaces historical health trends, recent autoscale events, burst decisions, and correlated cost changes for a single Dedicated GPU pool. The panel should be embeddable in the Pool Details page and available in a condensed form for fleet-level overviews. Context: PM and infra teams need a quick way to diagnose recent regressions and decide on manual burst actions without drilling into raw metrics. This design focuses on triage-first UX: concise signal, one-click mitigation (rollout / burst / fallback), and links to full dashboards for deep dive.
acceptance_criteria:
1) The panel shows a 48-hour timeline with prominent SLO violations highlighted and hoverable annotations for autoscale/burst events.
2) Each event card exposes the causal signals (latency p95, queue length, KV cache hit rate) as sparklines.
3) One-click actions: ‘Increase burst by X GPUs’, ‘Trigger canary rollback’, and ‘Open incident runbook’—all with confirm modals.
4) Compact mode collapses to a single-line summary with colored status chip and last-event timestamp.
5) Designs include accessibility considerations (color contrast, keyboard focus, aria labels).
review_notes: 2025-02-12 - PM review (Lena Ortiz): love triage-first approach; asked for clear mapping of events -> billing impact; requested per-event estimated cost delta.
2025-02-14 - Eng feedback (Ravi Patel): suggested limit on one-click burst to enforce guardrail policy; backend needs an API change for burst sizing; blocked on ENG-431110.
2025-02-16 - Accessibility review (Sofia Mendes): flagged insufficient contrast on orange alert band at small sizes; proposed stronger pattern and keyboard focus states.
2025-02-18 - Design critique (Design Team): approved layout with minor copy edits; asked for alternate small-screen stacking and a condensed legend state.
decisions: Show 48-hour default window with selector for 7d/30d (decided 2025-02-12)
Event cards will include computed estimated cost delta pulled from billing service v2 (decision 2025-02-12)
One-click actions require role check and will show guardrail warning if policy blocks (decision 2025-02-14)
Compact mode will hide sparkline details but keep status chips and last-event timestamp (decision 2025-02-16)
next_steps: Eng: Implement backend endpoints for per-event cost delta and burst API (linked issue ENG-431110)
Design: Produce responsive variants for <=1280px and compact-row for fleet view (owner: Marco Li)
PM: Validate priority of rolling this to Beta pools by 2025-03-15 (owner: Lena Ortiz)
QE: Add test cases for keyboard navigation and confirm modal flows

Open questions: How to represent correlated KV cache regressions vs noisy latency spikes? (proposal: correlation score with confidence band). How to surface multi-pool cascading events? (future: fleet-level propeller rollup).
implementation_notes: Frontend: React + Canvas sparklines; use existing timeline component from infra-ops package. Backend: new endpoint /pools/:id/events?window=48h returns list of events with cost_delta and correlation_score. Feature flag: feature.propeller_timeline_beta. Ensure non-blocking load if billing service times out.
final_comment: Ready for engineering handoff pending ENG-431110 unblock and a short dev spike to validate event API contract. Designer will pair with eng for first two sprints to iterate on real data.
